classification_policy.false_positive: An unmapped finding counted as incorrect.

ground_truth.title: Service unnecessarily exposed using LoadBalancer
ground_truth.rationale: A LoadBalancer service can expose the application outside the cluster. Services that do not require direct external access should use an internal service type such as ClusterIP and be exposed through controlled ingress mechanisms where appropriate.
